create_BertTextTransform: create a BertTextTransform instance to tokenize raw text into BERT token ID tensors
run_BertTextTransform_call: run the BertTextTransform on a list of raw text strings to get tokenized tensors
build_BERT_tokenizer_pipeline: build a BERT tokenizer pipeline with start and end tokens using BertTextTransform
test_BertTextTransform_padding: test the BertTextTransform padding behavior by transforming texts of varying lengths
review_BertTextTransform_init: review the BertTextTransform constructor to configure vocab file, lowercase, and token values
